note.question: How do characteristics of the operating and market environment affect the optimal sourcing strategy for single-origin beans?
note.overview: Leading specialty coffee roasters rely on direct trade to source premium coffee beans. The paper examines a roaster who sells two basic types of roasts: (1) a single-origin roast sourced from a specific locale and (2) a blend roast that uses a mix of beans from sources that vary over the course of a year. The prices of blend roasts are lower than those of single-origin roasts and appeal to a larger market.
